title: Day 1 Completion — SpendSense Ship
description: Finish Day 1: distinct SpendSense UI (Credex-inspired, not clone), Supabase persistence, public deploy, manual E2E, DEVLOG. All 6 MVP features must pass cross_check before marking complete.

steps.title: SpendSense UI rebrand
steps.notes: Use .agents/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md. Teal/indigo accent (not Credex green). Outfit + DM Sans fonts. Two-column hero. SpendSense wordmark; Credex only in footer + high-savings CTA.
steps.commit: feat(ui): SpendSense branding distinct from credex.rocks

steps.title: Wire metadata and share URLs

steps.title: Supabase setup
steps.verify: Submit audit, refresh /audit/[id] — data persists after server restart (not in-memory only)

steps.title: Manual E2E test
script: Open incognito -> landing loads SpendSense branding
Add 2+ tools with plans, seats, team size, use case
Verify savings hero, per-tool cards, AI summary
Submit email in lead form (check network 200)
Copy share URL -> open incognito -> no email/company on page
View page source -> og:title and twitter:card present

steps.title: Deploy to Vercel
manual_steps: Add all env vars from .env.example to Vercel project

steps.title: DEVLOG Day 1 + PROMPTS stub
steps.commit: docs: DEVLOG day 1 complete, PROMPTS stub

mvp_1_spend_form.label: Spend input form
items: All 8 tools selectable: cursor, github-copilot, claude, chatgpt, anthropic-api, openai-api, gemini, windsurf
Plan dropdown updates per tool with list prices shown
Monthly spend and seats per row
Team size and primary use case (coding/writing/data/research/mixed)
localStorage restores form on refresh (key: credex-audit-form-v1)
Honeypot field website hidden from users

mvp_2_audit_engine.label: Audit engine
items: POST /api/audit returns recommendations with dollar amounts
Each recommendation has 1-sentence reason with numbers
Rules cover: seat optimization, downgrade, alternative tool, credits path
isHighSavings true when total > $500/mo

mvp_3_results_page.label: Audit results page
items: Hero shows total monthly + annual savings prominently
Per-tool breakdown: current -> action -> savings + reason
Savings > $500/mo: Credex consultation CTA prominent
Savings < $100/mo: honest 'spending well' + notify signup
Visual quality: screenshot-ready SpendSense design

mvp_4_ai_summary.label: AI-generated summary
items: ~100 word paragraph shown on results page
With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Claude-generated summary
Without key or on API error: template fallback (no error shown to user)
PROMPTS.md stub exists (full prompt completed Day 2)

mvp_5_lead_capture.label: Lead capture + storage
items: Email capture AFTER results (not before audit)
Optional: company, role, team size
Stored in Supabase leads table (or documented fallback)
Honeypot phone field on lead form
Rate limit on /api/audit (10/IP/hour)
Resend email sent when RESEND_API_KEY set (graceful skip if missing)

mvp_6_shareable_url.label: Shareable result URL
items: Unique public URL /audit/[id]
No email or company name on public page
Tools and savings numbers visible
openGraph title, description, url set
twitter:card summary_large_image

ui_distinct.label: SpendSense distinct from credex.rocks
items: Product branded SpendSense in header (not Credex logo as primary)
Accent color teal/indigo (not Credex green headline)
Different hero layout (two-column or distinct structure)
Credex appears only: footer attribution, high-savings CTA, external nav link

ops.label: Operations
items: npm run build passes with zero errors
Deployed Vercel URL returns HTTP 200
.env.example committed; .env.local NOT committed
DEVLOG.md Day 1 filled with hours, learnings, blockers
ops.notes: Build passes; Vercel deploy pending user credentials

functional_checks: Full flow: form -> audit -> results -> email -> share
